integrity: The statement is a proof-level list refinement reconstructed from the randomized recoloring argument in arXiv:2609.21286v1. It is not attributed to the source authors as a stated theorem.
limitations: The random conclusion is edgewise almost sure, not the existence of one Borel realization proper on all edges simultaneously.
Sharpness is asserted for the universal uniform \(2d+1\) threshold; the nonuniform local quantity \(d+d_G^+(x)+1\) is not claimed pointwise optimal.
Targeted literature and semantic-database searches do not constitute an exhaustive historical novelty proof.
title: Randomized Borel list coloring at a local \(d+d_G^+(x)+1\) bound
